title: Rubber Stamp Travel Field Notes — five sheets
summary: The multi-result pack: one workflow, five outputs, one full uncropped result per slide. Three versions to pick from — two blurred-letterbox covers, one photo cover, and three different closers. Stills are generated stand-ins; see public/carousels/stamp-notes/README.md.
caption:
Five travel photos in. Five stamped sheets out. Same workflow every time — the place changes, the system doesn't.

Comment blend and we'll send it to you.
